note: Criteria sets the scoring report runs through rank and absolute scoring. Same shape as the optimiser's criteria. `expect` is what a good scoring method should show, read by a person, not checked.

scenarios.label: Start view: habitable, sunny, leaning left
scenarios.expect: Moderate. The criteria pull in different directions (the sunny south is the least habitable).

scenarios.label: Sunshine alone
scenarios.expect: Easy. The sunniest communes should score close to 1 under either method.

scenarios.label: Culture alone
scenarios.expect: Easy for big cities. Under rank, countryside communes still reach the middle; under absolute scoring they should score low.

scenarios.label: Habitable and cultured
scenarios.expect: Achievable: northern cities with good reach. Absolute scoring should agree on who is on top.

scenarios.label: Habitable, cultured and cheap
scenarios.expect: Conflicting: culture comes with high prices. The best score should fall clearly under absolute scoring.

scenarios.label: Lots of culture, low density
scenarios.expect: Nearly contradictory. Rank scoring will still find someone near the top; absolute scoring should not.
